title: 两个 Γ 形网络的级联
statement: 图示二端口由两个 Γ 形网络级联而成：N1 由串联电阻 R1 = 2 Ω 和并联电阻 R2 = 4 Ω 组成，N2 由串联电阻 R3 = 1 Ω 和并联电阻 R4 = 2 Ω 组成。
先分别写出 N1、N2 的 T 参数矩阵，再利用级联时 T = T1·T2 求整个二端口的 A、B、C、D（u1 = A·u2 − B·i2，i1 = C·u2 − D·i2，i2 从 2 端流入）。
hints: 串联阻抗 Z 的 T 矩阵是 [1 Z; 0 1]，并联导纳 Y 的 T 矩阵是 [1 0; Y 1]。Γ 形网络（先串后并）T = [1 + ZY  Z; Y  1]。
级联时前一级的输出电流 −i2 正好是后一级的输入电流，所以 T = T1·T2——注意矩阵乘法的顺序不能交换。
solution: **注意：** T2·T1 ≠ T1·T2——把两级的次序对调就是另一个二端口。

en.title: Cascade of two L sections
statement: The two-port is a cascade of two L sections: N1 has a series resistor R1 = 2 Ω and a shunt resistor R2 = 4 Ω; N2 has a series resistor R3 = 1 Ω and a shunt resistor R4 = 2 Ω.
Write the transmission (ABCD) matrices of N1 and N2, then use T = T1·T2 for a cascade to find A, B, C, D of the whole two-port (u1 = A·u2 − B·i2, i1 = C·u2 − D·i2, i2 flowing into terminal 2).

questions.explain: D = 0.25 × 1 + 1 × 1 = 1.25. Check AD − BC = 4.0625 − 3.0625 = 1 ✓ (the cascade is still reciprocal).

hints: A series impedance Z has the ABCD matrix [1 Z; 0 1], a shunt admittance Y has [1 0; Y 1]. An L section (series then shunt) has T = [1 + ZY  Z; Y  1].
In a cascade the output current −i2 of the first stage is exactly the input current of the second, so T = T1·T2 — the order of the matrix product matters.
solution: **4. Check:** AD − BC = 3.25 × 1.25 − 3.5 × 0.875 = 1 ✓. Directly from the definition: with port 2 open and u2 = 1 V, R4 carries 0.5 A, the middle node is at 1.5 V, R2 carries 0.375 A, i1 = 0.875 A and u1 = 1.5 + 2 × 0.875 = 3.25 V, matching A and C.
**Note:** T2·T1 ≠ T1·T2 — swapping the two stages gives a different two-port.
